scope: Counts describe this built package snapshot; they do not establish completeness or accuracy.

standard_nt_research.scope_note: Bundled standard-New-Testament research modules linked by work/title candidates; not canon-linked coverage, edition equivalence, accuracy, or completeness.

standard_ot_research.scope_note: Standard Old Testament USFM module links are research-only: Job and Chronicles modules have reviewed work/title matches based on the Church list and official USFM identifiers; the remaining links are uncertain title candidates. Reviewed title matches do not establish EOTC/Eritrean affiliation, edition identity, textual boundaries, completeness, or accuracy.

church_list.mapping_scope_note: Mapping state is evidence classification, not a completeness or accuracy score. A reviewed match here means a scoped work/title comparison against cited records, not scholarly peer review, edition identity, text collation, completeness, or accuracy.

reader_records.scope_note: Canon links are archive mappings, not certifications of edition identity, completeness, or textual accuracy.

language_profile_content_counts.scope_note: A profile is a language/script metadata record; the total profile count is not a count of languages with bundled text.

research_translation_provenance.scope_note: These are corpus metadata states. An established basis path means cited evidence identifies a source-language path; it does not certify translator workflow, wording accuracy, completeness, or community review. Unknown means the path is not established in this archive, not that no translation exists.
